For each project page, avoid long walls of text. Use the **Problem-Approach-Result (PAR)** model to make it scannable:

>[!info] Main Topics

|**Section**|**Content Focus**|
|---|---|
|**The Problem**|What was the challenge? Mention constraints (e.g., "Limited to 220kHz I2C speed" or "Processing 30k points/sec").|
|**The Approach**|What tools did you use? (Python, PlatformIO, Random Forest). Why did you choose them over alternatives?|
|**The Result**|**Quantify your success.** Instead of "it worked," say "reduced packet latency by 15%" or "achieved 92% classification accuracy on road hazards."|
